  "right": "{\"kind\":\"variable\",\"name\":\"y\",\"optional\":true,\"readonly\":false,\"static\":false,\"private\":false,\"protected\":false,\"public\":true,\"abstract\":false,\"async\":false}"

When you pass this JSON to the function, it will return a boolean indicating whether the declaration flags match (with the special allowance for optionality differences between parameters and variables).
